premises.text: Without centralized coordination, shippers cannot reliably fill trucks and truckers are empty or idle most of the time
premises.evidence_span: The truckers are empty or idle 93% of the time. Why? Again, because there's no centralized coordination or flexibility in the current system

premises.text: Lorry redirects and reassigns trucks when delays, weather, or port issues arise so journeys stay coordinated end-to-end
premises.evidence_span: if your truck is delayed or for some reason it's raining at the port and you can't load, we'll redirect the truck

premises.text: Operations teams get visualized loading, journey, and offload data with dashboards and live tracking for cargo owners
premises.evidence_span: we're providing our car owners with further visibility through dashboards and tracking mechanisms where you can see where your trucks are at any given stage live

premises.text: Word-of-mouth adoption among major commodity movers and transporters grows the network without paid marketing
premises.evidence_span: All of this is by word of mouth, and we've done no PR or marketing. It's all referrals

value.text: Power flexible, coordinated African logistics so goods cost less
